title: The verification step in INSTALL quoted an export size 12 KB out of date
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: Ran the block verbatim: the binary printed 379.7 KB where the page said 391.8 KB. The sample now elides the size and says why.

details:
INSTALL.md §2 walks a two-line demo session end to end and shows `will be 391.8 KB` and `wrote /tmp/demo.html (391.8 KB)`. The current binary prints 379.7 KB for that same session.

The number is almost entirely the compiled viewer, so it moves whenever the viewer does, and a reader comparing their output against the page sees a mismatch on the step whose whole job is to confirm the install worked.
